units: Percentage points: share_pct = 100 * matching reported bases / reported bases in the whole window. Null means not measurable, not zero.
sort_order: model_stock_bases descending within tied workloads; null last
data_id ascending for remaining exact ties
scope: ENA-indexed public INSDC metadata. Reported bases, not stored FASTQ bytes or market production. Class shares overlap and must not be added. Unknown organism labels remain in denominators. Genomic species pools include exact species plus space-separated suffixes; shrimp also pools the named Litopenaeus synonym; the broader M. tuberculosis complex label is excluded. Community material pools use exact recorded labels. No read-length, quality, target, cell or spatial protocol share is inferred.
